title: PennantPark Floating Rate Capital Ltd. Schedules Earnings Release of Third Fiscal Quarter 2026 Results
summary: MIAMI, July 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PennantPark Floating Rate Capital Ltd. (the "Company") (NYSE: PFLT) announced that it will report results for the third fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2026 on Monday, August 10, 2026 after the close of the financial markets. The post PennantPark Floating Rate Capital Ltd. Schedules Earnings Release of Third Fiscal Quarter 2026 Results appeared first on PennantPark .
